spans.s:
ind.
1 So, like, correlative to यथा as, &c.
2 Thus, (implying certainty.)
3 So, so be it, (implying assent or promise.)
4 Thus, then, therefore, (or reply.)
5 And, so, in (conjunction.)
E.
तद् that, थाल affix, implying manner.

m. (-तः)
A Jina or Buddha.
E.
तथा thus, (what really is,) and गत known, obtained.

ind.
And so, thus, even so.
E.
तथा, with च and.

n. (-त्वं)
Being so; the case or circumstances being admitted to be as stated.
E.
तथा, and त्व aff.

ind.
Nevertheless, yet, even.
E.
तथा, and अपि even.

mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
Of such a sort or kind.
E.
तथा, and विध sort.

ind.
So, even so, in the same manner.
E.
तथा, and एव thus.

mfn. (-थ्यः-थ्या-थ्यं)
True.
n. (-थ्यं)
Truth.
E.
तथा thus, (what, is really so,) and यत् aff.
